request.query: Lower bound on real powers from squared logarithmic estimate and base bounded below by two

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.le_pow_of_log_le",
      "informal_name": "Exponential Inequality: $x \\leq y^n$ if $\\log |x| \\leq n \\log y$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < y → Real.log x ≤ ↑n * Real.log y → x ≤ y ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For real numbers $x$ and $y$ with $y > 0$, if the natural logarithm of the absolute value of $x$ is less than or equal to $n$ times the natural logarithm of $y$, then $x$ is less than or equal to $y^n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.le_pow_clog",
      "informal_name": "Exponential Bound for Natural Logarithm Floor",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (x : ℕ), x ≤ b ^ Nat.clog b x",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $b > 1$ and any natural number $x$, it holds that $x \\leq b^{\\lfloor \\log_b x \\rfloor}$, where $\\lfloor \\log_b x \\rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to the base-$b$ logarithm of $x$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.zpow_le_of_le_log",
      "informal_name": "Exponential Inequality from Logarithmic Inequality",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℤ}, 0 < y → Real.log x ≤ ↑n * Real.log y → x ≤ y ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For real numbers $x > 0$ and $y > 0$ and integer $n$, if $\\log x \\leq n \\log y$, then $x \\leq y^n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.le_zpow_of_log_le",
      "informal_name": "Logarithmic Inequality Implies Power Inequality for Real Numbers",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℤ}, 0 < y → Real.log x ≤ ↑n * Real.log y → x ≤ y ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For a non-zero real number $ x $ and a positive real number $ y $, if $ \\ln|x| \\leq n \\ln y $, then $ x \\leq y^n $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Int.self_le_zpow_clog",
      "informal_name": "Integer Logarithm Upper Bound Inequality",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]\n  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r ≤ ↑b ^ Int.clog b r",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $b > 1$ and element $r$ in a floor semiring $R$, it holds that $r \\leq b^{\\lceil \\log_b \\lceil r \\rceil \\rceil}$ when $r \\geq 1$, and $r \\leq b^{-\\lfloor \\log_b \\lfloor r^{-1} \\rfloor \\rfloor}$ otherwise, where $\\lceil \\cdot \\rceil$ and $\\lfloor \\cdot \\rfloor$ denote ceiling and floor operations respectively.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Int.Log"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Exponential Inequality: $x \leq y^n$ if $\log |x| \leq n \log y$
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < y → Real.log x ≤ ↑n * Real.log y → x ≤ y ^ n
items.informal_description: For real numbers $x$ and $y$ with $y > 0$, if the natural logarithm of the absolute value of $x$ is less than or equal to $n$ times the natural logarithm of $y$, then $x$ is less than or equal to $y^n$.

items.informal_name: Exponential Bound for Natural Logarithm Floor

items.informal_description: For any natural number $b > 1$ and any natural number $x$, it holds that $x \leq b^{\lfloor \log_b x \rfloor}$, where $\lfloor \log_b x \rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to the base-$b$ logarithm of $x$.

items.informal_name: Logarithmic Inequality Implies Power Inequality for Real Numbers
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℤ}, 0 < y → Real.log x ≤ ↑n * Real.log y → x ≤ y ^ n
items.informal_description: For a non-zero real number $ x $ and a positive real number $ y $, if $ \ln|x| \leq n \ln y $, then $ x \leq y^n $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r ≤ ↑b ^ Int.clog b r
items.informal_description: For any natural number $b > 1$ and element $r$ in a floor semiring $R$, it holds that $r \leq b^{\lceil \log_b \lceil r \rceil \rceil}$ when $r \geq 1$, and $r \leq b^{-\lfloor \log_b \lfloor r^{-1} \rfloor \rfloor}$ otherwise, where $\lceil \cdot \rceil$ and $\lfloor \cdot \rfloor$ denote ceiling and floor operations respectively.
